description: This is a thermite-filled hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five turns before it detonates in a tight burst of intense heat; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the grenade.

description: This is an active thermite grenade, likely to burst into an intense thermal blast any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.no_deactivate_msg: You've already released the handle, try throwing it instead.
